dct_description_sm: The primary goal of this project was to analyse the mechanisms modulating the shift in predominant flow regimes, associated with the observed global warming in high-latitude regions of North America.  Considering that the Northwest Territories (NWT) is a region in which the most cold-season warming has occurred during the past five decades, we focussed our research on the details of the dynamic and thermodynamic processes associated with significant warming and cooling events in the NWT.  The 'Pineapple Express', typically responsible for significant warming, and cold-air mass formation in the NWT were studied extensively in support of this project.
dct_title_s: Climate data for the globe, the North American continent, and for northern Canada
